shortDescription: 1.4-inch AMOLED smartwatch with SpO2, heart rate and 7-day battery

name: Classic Building Blocks Set - 500 Pieces
description: Creative building set with 500 multicolour interlocking bricks in assorted shapes and sizes, made from non-toxic BPA-free ABS plastic. Encourages creativity and fine motor skills. Recommended for ages 4 and above.
